servicesHub.heroTitle: AI automation, UI/UX, and Next.js web development — for businesses that want to ship.
servicesHub.heroSubtitle: Three service tracks that compound on each other: AI automation to reclaim time, UI/UX to make flows obvious, web development to ship it fast.
servicesHub.tracksTitle: Pick one track. Or stack them.
servicesHub.tracksSubtitle: Each track stands on its own. They get sharper when combined — an audit informs the build, the build informs the UX, and the UX drives the next round of automation.
servicesHub.track1Summary: Repetitive work, off the team's plate. AI agents, no-code flows, and custom integrations that pay for themselves — measured in hours, not hype.
servicesHub.track1Cap2: AI agents and chatbots on streaming APIs
servicesHub.track2Summary: Interfaces that feel obvious and convert. Research, design, and iterate — until the user doesn't have to think twice.
servicesHub.track3Summary: Fast, accessible, type-safe web apps — from landing pages to AI-powered SaaS front-ends. Production-grade from day one.
servicesHub.track3Cap1: Next.js + React with App Router and RSC
servicesHub.track3Cap4: AI features wired to streaming APIs
servicesHub.track3Cap5: Core Web Vitals, SEO, structured data
servicesHub.processTitle: The same three steps, every project.
servicesHub.processSubtitle: Whether I'm building an automation flow, a design system, or a SaaS front end, the rhythm is the same.
servicesHub.process1Desc: Map the current state — workflows, screens, conversion paths. The cheapest step to skip, the most expensive one to skip.
servicesHub.process2Desc: Small, observable pieces. Every flow has a dashboard, every error has an alert, every retry has a story. No big-bang relaunches.
servicesHub.process3Desc: Watch what real users do and tune. The first version is the start of the conversation, not the end of the project.
servicesHub.diffTitle: A background that compounds on the brief.
servicesHub.diffSubtitle: The four edges that show up in the work, not just the headline.
servicesHub.diff1Desc: I've closed deals across LATAM. Empathy for the customer, sharp eye for the numbers.
servicesHub.diff2Desc: Versioned prompts, the way code should be. No black boxes, no hidden lock-in.
servicesHub.diff3Desc: Wireframes first, pixels second. I sit with engineering, review every PR, and tune live.
servicesHub.diff4Desc: TypeScript on the front, validated payloads on every API. Bugs stay rare, features stay fast.

servicesAi.heroSubtitle: Repetitive work, off the team's plate. AI agents, no-code flows, and custom integrations that pay for themselves — measured in hours, not hype.
servicesAi.heroImageAlt: eFlow automation flows dashboard: cart recovery, dynamic pricing, social publishing
servicesAi.stat1: faster product upload vs the manual workflow
servicesAi.stat2: automation flows in production across clients
servicesAi.stat3: reclaimed per month by clients on average
servicesAi.caseDesc: AI agents that bulk-upload products, write SEO copy, and ship to marketplaces — what used to be a 90-minute manual task now finishes in 15.
servicesAi.caseImageAlt: E-commerce automation case: products uploaded in bulk by an AI agent
servicesAi.cap1Desc: I sit with your team and map every repetitive step — from inbox triage to intake to fulfillment. The audit ends with a prioritized backlog of automations ranked by ROI.
servicesAi.cap2Desc: Conversational agents that answer customer questions, qualify leads, and route work to the right human. Built on OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models via streaming APIs.
servicesAi.cap3Desc: No-code and low-code flows that connect your CRM, email, calendar, sheets, and SaaS tools. Trigger to action, end to end, with logging and retry handling.
servicesAi.cap4Desc: Bulk product uploads, AI-generated descriptions and images from phone snapshots, and multi-platform publishing. The 90→15 minute case study from the portfolio — engineered for real stores.
servicesAi.cap5Desc: AI-driven scraping, enrichment, and personalized cold outreach that reads like a 1:1 message. Warm leads land in your CRM, ready for your sales team to close.
servicesAi.cap6Desc: Webhooks, REST and GraphQL APIs, OAuth flows, background jobs. When the SaaS you need doesn't exist, I build the bridge that does the job.
servicesAi.approachSubtitle: Five steps, every project. The same rhythm whether the deliverable is a saved hour or a shipped product.
servicesAi.approach1Desc: Every project starts with the workflow, not the tool. I dig into how your team actually works today, where time is leaking, and which automations pay for themselves in weeks — not quarters.
servicesAi.approach2Desc: Once the backlog is locked, I ship in small, observable pieces. Every flow has a dashboard, every error has an alert, every retry has a story.
servicesAi.approach3Desc: I treat prompts like code: version-controlled, evaluated against golden datasets, and rolled back when they drift. No black boxes on my watch.
servicesAi.approach4Desc: Your data stays where it belongs. Self-hosted models when privacy or cost demands it, third-party APIs when speed to ship matters more.
servicesAi.approach5Desc: After launch, I monitor what real traffic teaches and iterate. The first version is the start of the conversation, not the end of the project.

servicesUiUx.capabilitiesTitle: What I bring to the table
servicesUiUx.cap1Desc: User interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitive analysis. I dig into real behavior so the design follows from evidence, not assumptions.
servicesUiUx.cap2Desc: End-to-end flows that make the next step obvious. Wireframes that lock down structure before pixels take over.
servicesUiUx.cap3Desc: Production-ready UI in Figma with type, color, and spacing systems. Components that hold up at any screen size.
servicesUiUx.cap4Desc: Every screen has a job. I iterate on copy, layout, and CTA hierarchy so the path to conversion is short and obvious.
servicesUiUx.cap5Desc: Tokens, components, and documentation so design and engineering speak the same language. Less drift, faster shipping.
servicesUiUx.cap6Desc: Moderated and unmoderated sessions. Real users, real tasks, real metrics. I turn findings into a backlog your dev team can actually act on.
servicesUiUx.approachSubtitle: Five steps, every project. The same rhythm whether the deliverable is a one-screen fix or a full product redesign.
servicesUiUx.approach1Desc: I start by understanding the user and the business at the same time — neither one matters without the other. Empathy for the customer, sharp eye for the numbers.
servicesUiUx.approach2Desc: Once I've mapped the journey and locked the flow, I move fast on wireframes. Cheap to change, expensive to skip.
servicesUiUx.approach3Desc: Visual design comes after the structure is solid. I build a clear type and spacing system so screens feel consistent without being repetitive.
servicesUiUx.approach4Desc: Every interface gets tested. Five users catch 85% of usability problems, and the rest gets folded into the next sprint.
servicesUiUx.approach5Desc: Design doesn't stop at handoff. I sit with engineering, review every PR, and tune the live product when real-world data comes in.

privacy.metaDescription: How I collect, use, and protect your data on andresmorales.com.co.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data I collect when you use andresmorales.com.co, why I collect it, and what I do with it. I keep it short on purpose.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: When you submit the contact form or project brief, I receive the information you type (name, email, project details) plus technical metadata (IP address, timestamp, user agent) for spam protection. Plausible Analytics records anonymized page views without cookies or personal identifiers.
privacy.whyBody: To reply to your message, deliver the work we agreed on, prevent spam and abuse, and understand which pages are useful. I never sell your data. I never share it with third parties for marketing.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: Contact form submissions are emailed via Brevo (transactional email, EU-hosted). Project briefs also create a task in ClickUp (project management, US-hosted). Both processors are bound by data-processing agreements. Plausible Analytics is cookieless and self-hosted in the EU.
privacy.retentionBody: Form submissions stay in my inbox until the project is finished and invoiced, then archived for tax records. You can ask me to delete them earlier.
privacy.rightsBody: Under Colombia's Ley 1581/2012, Brazil's LGPD, and the EU's GDPR, you can request access, correction, deletion, or portability of your data at any time. Email info@andresmorales.com.co and I will respond within 15 business days.
privacy.changesBody: If I update this page I will change the date above. Material changes will be announced on the home page.
privacy.contactBody: Email info@andresmorales.com.co. I am the data controller.

terms.metaDescription: Terms governing the use of andresmorales.com.co and any services purchased from Andrés Morales.
terms.intro: By using this site or hiring me for a project, you agree to the terms below. Plain-English summary: be reasonable, pay what we agreed, I deliver what I promised.
terms.serviceBody: Service descriptions on this site are illustrative. The actual scope, deliverables, timeline, and price are defined in a written agreement (brief + proposal) before any work begins. Anything not in writing is not promised.
terms.ipBody: Code, designs, and content I create for you transfer to you upon full payment. I retain the right to display the work in my portfolio unless we agreed otherwise in writing. Portfolio case studies on this site describe real work and are used with permission.
terms.paymentBody: Payment terms (deposit, milestones, final payment) are set per project. Deposits are non-refundable once work has started. Unused prepaid hours expire after 12 months.
terms.liabilityBody: I am not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Total liability is capped at the amount you paid me in the 12 months before the claim.
terms.warrantyBody: I warrant that work is delivered with reasonable skill and care, and that I will fix defects in my work for 30 days after delivery at no extra cost.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Colombia. Disputes are resolved first through direct conversation, then mediation, then the courts of Bogotá.
